scenario: CRM software demo to a 20-person real-estate brokerage

seller.product: Brickline CRM (lead management CRM for real-estate brokers)
price_list: Starter ₹799 per user per month, billed annually
Growth ₹1,199 per user per month, billed annually (portal integrations, call recording)
10% off for annual upfront payment (rep's discretion)

speakers.name: Nikhil Deshpande
speakers.style: energetic account executive, loves showing features, rushes ahead

speakers.name: Farhan Qureshi
speakers.style: owner of Anchorpoint Realty, impatient, on the road, wants price first

speakers.name: Meenal Rao
speakers.style: operations and back-office head, practical, detail questions

coaching_truths.statement: When the owner asked for price up front, Nikhil quoted both per-user prices before learning team size, lead volume or pain, so the price landed with no value attached.
Nikhil cut Meenal off mid-question on data migration to show his favourite feature; she had to ask again who cleans the old data.
He first said the app supports Marathi, then corrected himself: only English and Hindi today, Marathi planned for Q1.
Meenal said they could have the whole team live before the January launches; Nikhil moved on to another report instead of locking a go-live date.
On the PropDesk price comparison he asked why they dropped it, tied the price to their own 60 missed leads and commission per booking, and answered the adoption worry with a weekly adoption report.
